verdict.rationale: Bun's own docs cover the core of this story. It supports npm-style `workspaces` in package.json for monorepos, with full glob syntax including negative patterns. Local packages reference each other via the `workspace:*` protocol, and the workspace tooling around that is rich: `--filter`, catalogs, self-contained hoisting barriers, workspace-aware add/remove, and `bun publish -r` in dependency order. `bun install` writes one `bun.lock`, though the docs never explicitly say it is a single root lockfile shared by all workspaces. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that one root lockfile covers every workspace, and independent or hands-on corroboration of monorepo use (the one community comment on this is only hesitation, not a test).
